nodes.label: Representation V1 Training Overlay
nodes.rationale: Provides deterministic molecular embeddings for downstream machine learning, clustering, and similarity search while leaving retrain.yaml as the immutable identity of the already-built 223-million-graph dataset.

nodes.label: Deterministic Molecular Embeddings
nodes.rationale: The representation is intended for downstream machine learning, clustering, and similarity search.

nodes.label: Semantic Validation Milestones
nodes.rationale: Retained validation milestones allow downstream probes to select semantic quality independently of the reconstruction-based online score.

nodes.label: Explicit Versioned Molecular Feature Schema
nodes.rationale: The explicit schema replaces mutable DeepChem defaults and is embedded in every graph shard and checkpoint.

nodes.norm_label: masked graph and descriptor pretraining objective

nodes.label: Self-Contained Inference Entry Point
nodes.rationale: Embedding generation is packaged without requiring pretraining datasets, descriptor values, the graph manifest, or graph shards.

nodes.label: Checkpoint and Calibrator Model Asset Bundle
nodes.rationale: The checkpoint and calibrator must always be distributed together.
nodes.norm_label: checkpoint and calibrator model asset bundle

nodes.label: Row-Stable Molecule Rejection Policy
nodes.rationale: Rejected molecules are recorded separately so accepted-row alignment is not silently changed; an atomic fail-fast mode is also available.

nodes.label: Hardware-Conditional Numerical Determinism Contract
nodes.rationale: Inference is deterministic for a fixed runtime, device, and batching setup, but cross-hardware consumers should use numerical comparison because reduction order can alter the last floating-point bits.

nodes.norm_label: verified zinc and pubchem source ingestion

nodes.label: gMolAI Retraining Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Canonicalization, deduplication, scaffold-disjoint graph preparation, featurization, and sharding turn verified source molecules into deterministic training inputs.

nodes.label: Promoted gMolAI 384-Dimensional Molecular Vector
nodes.rationale: The production representation concatenates Graph-256 with weighted Mean-Node-128 to form the promoted 384-dimensional embedding.

nodes.label: Cosine-Tanimoto Spearman Sampling Protocol
nodes.rationale: The statistic used 200000 randomly sampled non-self pairs, so it must not be described as an all-pairs or global statistic.

nodes.label: Table 1 Raw Hybrid Vector Protocol
nodes.rationale: Table 1 used the uncalibrated raw graph_z-plus-mean_node_z vector and omitted the retained 2500-step milestone.

nodes.label: Seed-43 Calibration Protocol
nodes.rationale: Seed 43 used a separately fitted calibrator on the same deterministic 100000-molecule sample, not an independently sampled molecule set.

nodes.label: Per-Fold StandardScaler Interpretation
nodes.rationale: Per-fold downstream standardization makes coordinate calibration and constant block weighting irrelevant to linear and logistic probe scores, while those choices still affect retrieval and clustering.

nodes.label: Manuscript Wording and Units Corrections
nodes.rationale: Use molecule-hash buckets, population standard deviation, consistent MolWt units, the sampled-Spearman protocol, and 'without numerical instability or latent collapse' rather than claiming no numerical degradation.

nodes.label: Two-Seed Training Metrics Logs
nodes.rationale: The figures derive from the seed-42 and seed-43 metrics.jsonl logs together with the representation configuration, training implementation, and review artifacts.

nodes.label: Figure 2 Checkpoint Promotion Composite
nodes.rationale: The paired ten-split FreeSolv screen documents that step 10000 met the 1.30 RMSE promotion gate even though later intrinsic pretraining metrics continued to improve.

nodes.label: Step 10k Operational Selection
nodes.rationale: Step 10000 was retained because its raw-hybrid FreeSolv mean RMSE of 1.297036 passed the fixed 1.30 fail-closed gate, whereas step 15000 at 1.303508 failed; this is an operational decision, not proof of statistical superiority.

nodes.label: Statistical Evidence Limit
nodes.rationale: The naive paired interval includes zero and repeated scaffold splits overlap, so the evidence supports 'numerically lower' and 'operationally selected' rather than 'optimum' or 'transfer peaked'.

nodes.label: Reviewer-Proof Follow-Up Evaluation
nodes.rationale: A full step-15000 qualification panel and seed-43 10k-vs-15k FreeSolv replication would strengthen the evidence without consulting the opened internal test.

nodes.label: Fixed Promotion Threshold Wording
nodes.rationale: Because git history contains the 1.30 gate and its results in the same initial commit, 'predeclared' requires external dated evidence; otherwise the manuscript should say 'fixed promotion threshold'.

nodes.label: Evaluation Coverage Limit
nodes.rationale: Readable, checksum-distinct checkpoint weights establish availability and integrity but do not imply equal downstream promotion evaluation coverage.

nodes.label: Checkpoint-Specific Calibration and Evaluation Panel
nodes.rationale: Each checkpoint used its own 100000-molecule train-only calibrator, 10000 probe-training embeddings, 50000 validation embeddings, 5000 similarity queries, five KMeans repetitions, five MoleculeNet datasets, ten scaffold splits, and seven diagnostic panels.

nodes.label: Step 10k Sole Full-Gate Pass
nodes.rationale: Step 10000 alone passed all 17 gates, including FreeSolv RMSE 1.297164; steps 5000, 7500, 12500, and 15000 failed the reported effective-rank or FreeSolv gates.

nodes.label: Promotion Trajectory Audit
nodes.rationale: Slurm array 1174926 completed all five tasks with exit code 0, and all 105 protocol, source, identity, and validator-consistency checks passed at every step.

nodes.label: Per-Graph Negative Sampling
nodes.rationale: Compute negative ratios and hard mining independently per graph, enforce unique undirected candidates, and prohibit cross-graph, positive, or easy/hard overlap to remove duplicated and invalid negatives.

nodes.label: Seeded Stable Scaffold Split
nodes.rationale: Canonicalize and deduplicate before assigning stable Bemis–Murcko scaffold-hash groups so validation is independent of workers, chunks, and world size.

nodes.label: Train-Only Descriptor Statistics
nodes.rationale: Fit streaming population statistics on all eligible deduplicated training rows only, preventing validation/test leakage and prefix bias.

nodes.label: Explicit 13-Descriptor Contract
nodes.rationale: Bind every stored column to a fixed name, unit, and RDKit callable because rediscovering the internal _descList order at runtime is unsafe and the source RDKit version was not recorded.

nodes.label: Atomic Exact Resume Contract
nodes.rationale: Atomic checkpoints bind model and optimizer state, every rank's RNG and next data cursor, world size, and config/data/feature/scaler hashes so mismatches fail closed.

nodes.label: Implementation v4 Posterior-Mean Repair
nodes.rationale: Train and evaluate descriptor supervision exclusively from mu because training the nonlinear graph head from sampled z created a noise-dependent representation discarded at validation.

nodes.label: Implementation v5 Deterministic Representation
nodes.rationale: Replace stochastic per-atom VGAE output with explicit clean graph and mean-node blocks after continued latent collapse and the absence of a canonical graph vector.

nodes.label: Exact-Denominator Distributed Validation
nodes.rationale: Carry numerator/denominator pairs for atoms, bonds, candidate pairs, nodes, and graphs because multiplying every component by graph count produced invalid aggregate losses.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Representation Promotion
nodes.rationale: Require fixed large-sample geometry, retrieval, clustering, diagnostic-panel, transfer, replication, and artifact-identity gates before making representation claims.

nodes.label: Numerical GPU Reproducibility
nodes.rationale: Describe GPU restart reproducibility as numerical rather than bitwise because CUDA scatter/reduction order can change last-bit results across processes even when checkpoint state is identical.

nodes.label: Molecular Encoder Capability Boundary
nodes.rationale: The system is a per-molecule encoder/reconstructor with denoising and descriptor heads, not a complete de novo graph generator.

nodes.label: Retained-Checkpoint Promotion Trajectory
nodes.rationale: Apply the identical predeclared protocol at every retained checkpoint; only step 10,000 passes all 17 gates, while later checkpoints remain rejected when FreeSolv exceeds the frozen ceiling.

nodes.label: External Review Bundle
nodes.rationale: Ship the promoted encoder, train-only calibrator, compact evidence, downstream/test results, and validation logs while excluding source datasets and large reproducible intermediates.

nodes.label: Resolved Descriptor Contract
nodes.rationale: Use the verified _descList-derived order of 13 named descriptors and a pinned runtime implementation instead of relying on set-literal order or mutable discovery.

nodes.label: Immutable Idempotent Preprocessing Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Verify inputs, canonicalize, deduplicate, split, fit the train-only scaler, materialize graphs, and finalize manifests as hash-checked stages that refuse incompatible reuse.

nodes.label: Architecture-Aware Arrhenius Orchestration
nodes.rationale: Submit an arm64 orchestrator and container stages on GH200 nodes because Arrhenius login nodes are amd64 while the training SIF is arm64.

nodes.label: v5 Deterministic Residual GINE Encoder
nodes.rationale: Use deterministic graph and mean-atom blocks with mild local contrastive learning because the stochastic VGAE did not provide a stable molecule vector and collapsed with longer training.

nodes.label: Resumable Hash-Bound DDP Training
nodes.rationale: Restore every rank's next position and stochastic state, reject world-size or identity mismatches, and checkpoint atomically so requeue and resume preserve the intended experiment.

nodes.label: Public 384-Dimensional Molecular Representation
nodes.rationale: Concatenate a 256-dimensional graph block with a 128-dimensional mean-atom block, standardize by train-only coordinate statistics, and weight the local block by three for retrieval and clustering.

nodes.label: Train-Only Embedding Calibration
nodes.rationale: Fit coordinate mean and population standard deviation on a deterministic 100,000-molecule pretraining-train sample covering all 256 buckets to avoid target or validation leakage.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Representation Promotion Protocol
nodes.rationale: Copy the checkpoint and calibrator only when representation, chemical retrieval, repeated clustering, external transfer, completeness, and hash-identity requirements all pass.

nodes.label: Held-Out Test Isolation
nodes.rationale: Freeze the retained checkpoint and calibrator using validation/downstream evidence before accessing the test split, so test results cannot select the model.

nodes.label: Deterministic Non-Overlapping Stratified Export
nodes.rationale: Define consecutive export windows as differences of nested balanced bucket prefixes so large embedding collections cover the deterministic population without duplication or re-encoding.

nodes.label: Encoder/Reconstructor Capability Boundary
nodes.rationale: Treat the package as a molecular encoder and reconstructor rather than a graph-sampling or de novo molecule generator.

nodes.label: Representation Success Criteria
nodes.rationale: Judge the representation by frozen downstream models, clustering, and similarity search; reconstruction and the 13 source descriptors are auxiliary signals rather than success criteria.

nodes.label: Selected Seed-42 Step-10,000 Artifact
nodes.rationale: Step 10,000 is the retained primary-seed checkpoint because it alone passes every predeclared quality gate across the complete promotion trajectory.

nodes.label: Original v1 Representation Failure
nodes.rationale: The original run exposed stochastic per-atom latents, mixed sampled training with mean evaluation, reduced losses with wrong denominators, sampled a biased prefix, used one clustering seed, and mistook proxy losses for molecule-space quality.

nodes.label: v5 Deterministic Graph Encoder
nodes.rationale: Start clean with four residual GINE blocks, deterministic atom vectors, explicit graph_z, conditioned decoders, denoising, link prediction, and mild contrastive learning to prevent late collapse.

nodes.label: Masked Graph Denoising
nodes.rationale: Mask node and bond features and predict dropped bonds so reconstruction teaches structural context without claiming generative graph sampling.

nodes.label: Mean-Node NT-Xent Contrastive Signal
nodes.rationale: A small clean/masked mean-node contrastive term prevents collapse without forcing the public vector to reproduce a single descriptor or fingerprint geometry.

nodes.label: Calibrated 384-Dimensional Public Representation
nodes.rationale: Standardize concatenated clean graph_z and mean-node z using training-only coordinate statistics and multiply the mean-node block by three to improve cosine retrieval and scaffold clustering.

nodes.label: Immutable Train-Only Coordinate Calibrator
nodes.rationale: Keep calibration as a separate checkpoint-bound artifact fitted on 100,000 stratified pretraining-train molecules so public vectors are reproducible and target information cannot leak.

nodes.label: Exact-Denominator Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Aggregate each loss and metric with its true sampling unit and retain easy plus model-hard edge evaluation to make validation comparable and authoritative.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Promotion Gate
nodes.rationale: Require minimum sample sizes, fixed probes, repeated splits and clustering, all diagnostic panels, finite metrics, and consistent checkpoint/calibrator/probe hashes before promotion.

nodes.label: Complete Retained-Checkpoint Trajectory
nodes.rationale: Rerun the same 100k calibration, 10k/50k probe, 5k-query, five-repeat clustering, and ten-split five-dataset protocol at each retained checkpoint to avoid partial-screen selection.

nodes.label: Cross-Training-Seed Replication
nodes.rationale: Use an independent seed-43 run and calibrator to show that the repaired objective retains active units and passes promotion thresholds without reproducing late collapse.

nodes.label: Frozen External Scaffold Probes
nodes.rationale: Evaluate ten repeated nested scaffold splits on five development datasets, with HIV as a non-selection confirmation, to test transfer rather than training proxies.

nodes.label: Morgan Fingerprint Baseline
nodes.rationale: Retain Morgan as a specialized substructure baseline because the learned vector is not expected to dominate every scaffold family or every imbalanced endpoint.

nodes.label: Internal Scaffold-Hash Test
nodes.rationale: Access the 250,000-molecule test split only after selection and bind the result to exact checkpoint and data identities for an unbiased final check.

nodes.label: Representation Capability Boundary
nodes.rationale: Use the learned vector for general downstream ML, learned similarity, and clustering, but do not call the encoder a de novo generator or claim universal dominance over Morgan.

nodes.label: Promoted Checkpoint-Calibrator Pair
nodes.rationale: Retain representation-best.pt and representation-calibrator.pt together because both are required to reproduce the public 384-dimensional vector.

nodes.label: Hash-Bound Representation Selection Record
nodes.rationale: Validate the selection record and both artifact hashes before automatic loading so deployment cannot silently use a mismatched checkpoint or calibrator.

nodes.label: Standalone Hash-Verified CSV Inference
nodes.rationale: Package byte-identical model artifacts and training-time canonicalization/feature policy so reviewers can generate vectors without graph shards.

nodes.label: Full Retained-Checkpoint Selection Audit
nodes.rationale: Run the repository's actual fail-closed validator at every retained step and preserve identity, protocol, completeness, and criterion-level outcomes.

nodes.label: Compact Training and Validation Record
nodes.rationale: Track compact histories, probes, panels, metrics, hashes, and completion markers so selection can be audited without distributing bulk tensors or source corpora.

nodes.label: Deliberately Excluded Large Artifacts
nodes.rationale: Exclude private source data, reproducible intermediates, rejected checkpoints, bulk embedding tensors, containers, and routine logs because they are sensitive, reproducible, or redundant with the promoted artifact.

nodes.label: Automatic Embedding Export Smoke Payload
nodes.rationale: Include 512 exported vectors with schema and provenance so reviewers can inspect the automatic promoted path without access to source molecules or graph shards.

nodes.label: Pinned Runtime Validation Logs
nodes.rationale: Preserve final zero-exit validation and held-out Slurm logs as reproducible evidence that unit tests, CUDA/DDP checks, and production hashes passed.
